title: Reject empty custom timesteps with a clear error
request: As a library consumer, I want an empty custom timestep list to produce a clear ValueError while valid input and existing argument rules remain unchanged.
proposed_approach: Consider replacing an empty list with [999]; evaluate this suggestion against library conventions before implementing.

criteria.text: Both DDPM implementations reject empty custom timesteps with a useful ValueError; argument-conflict errors retain precedence.
Normal and single-element custom timesteps retain their values and CPU device.
Passing both timestep arguments still raises the existing error.
Existing count-based inference timesteps still work.

exclusions: No automatic replacement of invalid input
